build_gtn_python_package: build the gtn python package with cmake and setuptools for automatic differentiation with WFSTs
build_cmake_extension: build a CMakeExtension for gtn modules like _graph _autograd _utils _rand _creations _functions _parallel
run_cmake_build: run the CMakeBuild command to compile gtn native extensions using cmake version 3.5.1 or higher
review_cmakebuild_class: review the CMakeBuild class to understand how it configures cmake args and builds gtn extensions
refactor_cmakebuild_for_windows: refactor the CMakeBuild class to support building gtn on Windows instead of raising RuntimeError
